text:
maria_cs: Heads up — VeridianHealth renewal in 6w. Noticed a sharp drop in activity: last 7d token use down ~78% vs baseline. New Head of Data started last week and procurement is running a short competitive pilot. Need quick triage.
ajay_ae: Thanks. Who can own the outreach? I have a procurement call Thurs at 3pm PT; would be useful to have a short health pack by then.
sophie_se: I can run a tech health check. Any error spikes or auth failures from their side? :thinking:
usage-bot: quick-stats: 7d_tokens=12,450 (baseline=56,800); active_seats=7 (baseline=18); avg_latency +6ms; errors_5xx=0; batch_jobs_failed=2
maria_cs: No 5xx in infra, looks behavioral — mainly batch/automation jobs paused after the new hire. They also flagged cost as a concern in the pilot. Competitive vendor is doing a narrower, cheaper reranking flow.
ajay_ae: OK — two threads to address: 1) restore automated jobs / onboarding touchpoint with new Head of Data, 2) pricing/cost comparison vs pilot. I'll own outreach to procurement. Sophie, can you capture quick config recs for lower cost run with similar quality?
sophie_se: Yep. I can propose: smaller batch window, prefix caching enabled, and aggressive KV cache TTL for their use-case. Quick pseudo-config I can share:
```
batch.max_tokens: 1024
cache.prefix_kv: true
cache.ttl_days: 3
quant.profile: int8-dynamic (eval for accuracy drift)
```
sophie_se: Also can run a 2-hour A/B with their sample reranking set to compare quality vs cheaper model.
devon_pm: From product side, we can offer a temporary credit to cover the A/B and buy time for the renewal conversation. Recommend up to 30k tokens credit + a co-run with SEs. Approve?
maria_cs: Approve the credit offer. Ask AE to mention co-run in outreach. Ajay, please cc me and @sophie_se on the invite.
ajay_ae: Will do. Draft outreach:
"Hi Team — quick check-in after your new Head of Data joined. We noticed some automation jobs paused and your seat activity dropped. Would you like a short co-run with our SEs + a 2-hour A/B to compare cost/quality? We can cover the tokens for the test. Available Thurs 3pm or Fri 10am PT?" 
ajay_ae: sending now. cc: @maria_cs @sophie_se :email:
maria_cs: Nice. Also ask for their sample reranking dataset and current cost per 1000 queries so Sophie can size the A/B.
sophie_se: I'll prepare a short checklist for the co-run (data, expected queries, target metric like MRR@10). Can do analysis in <24h after we get sample.
usage-bot: query-link: https://console.redwood.ai/usage/VeridianHealth?range=7d
maria_cs: Great — owners: Ajay=customer outreach, Sophie=tech co-run & config, Maria=renewal playbook / exec briefing. Next update here after their reply or after Thurs call. :thumbsup:
ajay_ae: Noted. If procurement pushes pricing, we can propose a dedicated throughput discount if they commit to a 6-12 month Dedicated plan — will prep numbers.
maria_cs: Thanks team. Keeping this thread as the single source for notes."
